meta.note: Reusable research artefacts — data, instruments, software — that someone else can download and cite. Kept separate from data/publications.json because a paper describes a result and an artefact is one: the paper is the citation, the repository is the thing. Rendered into /research/ by tools/build_artifacts.py, which also feeds the Dataset markup written by tools/build_jsonld.py.
meta.unverified: The OSF pages could not be read from the build environment, so licences and any DOIs minted by OSF itself are not recorded here. Add them once checked; each entry deliberately cites the paper's DOI, which is the citation the authors ask for.

artifacts.name: The Storytime Dataset
artifacts.summary: Simulated videotelephony clips for research on quality perception — recorded material for experiments in which participants rate audiovisual quality under controlled degradations.

artifacts.name: The STAGA-Dataset
artifacts.summary: Stop and trip annotated GPS and accelerometer data from everyday life — labelled mobility traces for developing and benchmarking methods that tell movement apart from standing still.
